set.body:
Outcome

Replace the current ROI-centered MVPA ontology with one clean public architecture: identified axes and typed linear evidence, purpose-specific designs, fixed or frozen measurement frames, open estimands, scientific plans, execution plans, and typed results. Prediction and relational geometry are sibling estimand families sharing this waist.

End state

- One public mvpa module and vocabulary.
- Multivar supplies semantic linear algebra; Resample4s supplies compiled ordinal designs; Alder supplies the predictive lifecycle; Crossform supplies relational laws and ontology.
- Preserve proven numerical and operator kernels while deleting the old public ontology.
- No compatibility namespace, adapter artifacts, parallel result system, or indefinite deprecation layer.
